The '''HE-2 Arbiter Droid''' was a model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was used at the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] near the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They carried [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]].
